1170-7907-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.

141-3905-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3905-6797.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7236.easyPrerequisites: The total toughness of creatures you control excluding Towering Titan is at least X.
6495-6972-7236.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Towering Titan.
When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7236.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature

Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 5.

Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6967-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.

When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

Repeat from step 2

1368-3755-6321-6965.description:

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

527-1409-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4681-5170-7452.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.

When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2178-2759.description:
Give Kelsien deathtouch by any method.
Activate Kelsien by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target creature and destroying it due to Kelsien's deathtouch.
The creature dies, triggering Kelsien twice.
Resolve the first Kelsien trigger, causing you to get an experience counter.
Resolve the second Kelsien trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent control.

250-779-1479-1669-2907.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-2907.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

141-3269-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3269-5686.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3269-5686.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

81-1636-2034-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
81-1636-2034-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters plus one due to Kami of Whispered Hopes on Sin.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters plus an additional +1/+1 counter on Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

1069-3499-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3499-3552-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

813-957-5895.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
813-957-5895.notes: If desired, you can do steps 2 and 3 during the first extra turn instead to spread out the mana costs.

Resolve the Myojin of Roaring Blades ability, dealing 7 damage to each of up to three opponents.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
81-186-2060-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Greedy Freebooter.

Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

You control a creature with power 4 or greater.

Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.

When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dualcaster Mage's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.

Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

The Goatnapper token enters the battlefield, untapping Kiki-Jiki.

Sword of the Paruns attached to Karametra's Acolyte

Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

At the beginning of your next upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, winning you the game.
